lines.text: Many learners say: I will pass my vacation in Spain.
Better: I will spend my vacation in Spain.
Spend! I spend my weekend at home.

data.wrong: I will pass my vacation in Spain.
data.right: I will spend my vacation in Spain.

native.tip: « Passer ses vacances » se dit “spend”. “Pass” veut dire donner ou réussir.
native.caption: Vous dites “I will pass my vacation in Spain.” ? Faux ami ! Dites plutôt “I will spend my vacation in Spain.” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.tip: To use time, say “spend”. “Pass” means hand over or succeed.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will pass my vacation in Spain.” False friend! Say “I will spend my vacation in Spain.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
